name: MyQuizGPT – Quiz Maker
author: myquizgpt

sections.description:
MyQuizGPT WordPress Quiz Maker is the ultimate WordPress quiz plugin designed specifically for teachers, educators, schools, training organizations, and educational content creators who want to embed quizzes and flashcards to their WordPress blogs and websites. Built for ease of use and powered by AI (ChatGPT), this plugin turns ordinary content into engaging study tools — perfect for educational blogs, online courses, knowledge assessments, and exam quizzes.

Whether you’re building quizzes with automatic results, embedding study materials, or creating exam-style tests, MyQuizGPT Quiz Maker gives you the complete toolkit you need — with clean design, responsive displays, and seamless WordPress integration.

Why Educators & Bloggers Choose MyQuizGPT WordPress Quiz Maker

WordPress quiz plugins come in many shapes and sizes. Some focus on marketing or lead generation, others on personality quizzes or simple trivia. What sets MyQuizGPT WordPress Quiz Maker apart is that it’s specifically tailored for education and learning, with a workflow optimized for high-quality quizzes and flashcards created using ChatGPT — without requiring developers or complex setups.

Below are the core reasons educators love this plugin:

  • ✔ AI-Driven Quiz & Flashcard Creation — Use ChatGPT’s power to generate structured quiz and flashcard content in seconds.
  • ✔ Designed for WordPress — Works with posts, pages, and custom layouts via shortcodes and standalone quiz pages.
  • ✔ Automatic Results & Scoring Logic — Built-in logic to calculate scores and show results immediately after quiz completion.
  • ✔ Responsive & Mobile-Friendly — Quizzes adapt to all devices automatically — no extra mobile plugin needed.
  • ✔ Smart Randomization — Automatically shuffles questions and answers for each quiz attempt, preventing memorization and ensuring fair assessments.
  • ✔ Dark & Bright Theme Customization — Users can switch between light and dark themes, with preferences saved automatically for a personalized viewing experience.
  • ✔ Educational Focus — Created for teachers, schools, trainers, and educators rather than general marketing or personality quizzes.

How MyQuizGPT WordPress Quiz Maker Works – Simplified in 3 Steps

Unlike other plugins where you manually build a quiz question-by-question, MyQuizGPT Quiz Maker combines structured quiz data with a smart WordPress viewer.

  1. Generate With ChatGPT: Use the built-in “Open ChatGPT Instructions” button to send a prompt that creates a JSON quiz or flashcard set in ChatGPT.
  2. Paste Into the Plugin Dashboard: Copy the JSON response and paste it directly into the MyQuizGPT Quiz Maker admin panel.
  3. Publish Anywhere: Embed the quiz with a simple shortcode: [myquizgpt id="123"] or use a standalone “App-style” URL (e.g., /q/quiz/123) to share or link to the quiz.

This workflow empowers educators to focus on content — not plugin mechanics.

Comprehensive Features

  • AI-Powered Quiz & Flashcard Creation
    Automatically structure quiz/flashcard content using ChatGPT. Supports multiple-choice, true/false, open-ended, and exam-style content. Eliminates manual question entry.

  • Quiz Results with Instant Scoring
    Automatically calculates and displays results when the quiz is completed. Shows correct/incorrect answers and performance summaries.

  • Multiple Embed Options
    Shortcodes — Place quizzes anywhere in posts, pages, or widgets. Standalone URLs — Create dedicated quiz pages that feel like mini-apps (/q/quiz/).

  • Responsive & Modern UI with Theme Customization
    Clean, readable interface with full responsiveness. Users can customize their viewing experience by switching between bright (light) and dark themes. Theme preferences are automatically saved and remembered for future visits, ensuring a personalized and comfortable learning environment.

  • Flashcards Support
    Create interactive flashcards with 3D flip animations. Ideal for vocabulary and concept checks.

  • Built-In Educational Logic with Smart Randomization
    Auto-Advance moves to the next question automatically. Smart Randomization shuffles both questions and answer options for each quiz attempt, ensuring that students can’t memorize answer positions and creating a fair, varied assessment experience every time.

  • Viral Sharing Tools
    Integrated social sharing buttons (Facebook, Twitter, Copy Link). Drives traffic back to your WordPress site.

  • Optional Branding Display
    Control whether to show the “Powered by MyQuizGPT” link. The branding is optional and defaults to hidden, allowing you to help readers discover the tool if you choose.

  • Fast & Optimized
    Asset versioning and built-in cache purging ensures quizzes load quickly.

Who Should Use MyQuizGPT WordPress Quiz Maker?

  • Teachers & Professors — Embed tests, assessments, and review quizzes on school websites.
  • Educational Bloggers — Add engaging interactive content that boosts time on page.
  • Training & Workshop Leaders — Embed knowledge checks after lessons.
  • Online Course Creators — Add graded quizzes to course modules.
  • Tutors & Coaches — Deliver personalized learning experiences right on WordPress.

How to Create a Quiz in WordPress Without a Plugin (ChatGPT Method)

Even if someone wants to know how to create a quiz in WordPress without a plugin, MyQuizGPT WordPress Quiz Maker has you covered — because it uses ChatGPT to generate structured quiz content that you can paste directly into WordPress — eliminating the need for manual question entry. Here’s how:
1. Open the “ChatGPT Instructions” inside the plugin.
2. Let ChatGPT output a properly structured JSON quiz or flashcard set.
3. Paste the JSON into the MyQuizGPT WordPress Quiz Maker dashboard.
4. Embed the resulting quiz using a shortcode or standalone URL.

Privacy

Data Collection and Storage:

This plugin stores the following data locally in your WordPress database:

  • Quiz Content: Quiz titles, questions, answers, and flashcard content are stored in a custom database table (wp_myquizgpt_quizzes).
  • Creator Information: The WordPress user ID of the person who created each quiz is stored for administrative purposes.
  • Plugin Settings: Your branding display preference is stored as a WordPress option.

What Data is NOT Collected:

  • The plugin does NOT collect any personal information from quiz takers or visitors.
  • The plugin does NOT track quiz completion, scores, or user interactions.
  • The plugin does NOT send any data to external servers (except for optional promotional links to MyQuizGPT.com Classroom Plan).
  • The plugin does NOT use cookies or tracking scripts.

Local Storage:

The plugin uses browser localStorage (client-side only) to remember user theme preferences (light/dark mode) for quiz viewers. This data is stored locally in the user’s browser and is never transmitted to any server.

Data Retention:

Quiz data is stored in your WordPress database until you manually delete it through the plugin’s admin interface. You have full control over all stored data.

Your Responsibility:

As the site administrator, you are responsible for:
* Complying with applicable privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) regarding quiz content and any personal data you may collect separately.
* Informing users if your quizzes collect any additional data through other means.
* Managing and securing your WordPress database where quiz data is stored.

External Services

This plugin does not require any external services to function. All features work locally on your WordPress installation.

Optional External Service: MyQuizGPT.com Classroom Plan

The plugin includes an optional promotional section that mentions the MyQuizGPT Classroom Plan, which is a separate service hosted on MyQuizGPT.com. This service provides additional features like classroom management, student progress tracking, and lesson creation. The Classroom Plan is completely optional and not required for the plugin to function.

Service Information:
* View Pricing Plans
* Terms of Service
* Privacy Policy

Note: The plugin is fully functional without any external services. All quiz creation, storage, and display features work entirely within your WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the myquizgpt-quiz-maker folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP via Plugins > Add New > Upload.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to MyQuizGPT in the dashboard to begin.
  4. (Optional) Save your permalink settings for proper standalone pages.
sections.faq:
Q: Where do I get quiz content?
A: Click “Open ChatGPT Instructions” in the plugin dashboard — it opens ChatGPT with a pre-filled prompt to generate your quiz JSON.

Q: Is MyQuizGPT Quiz Maker mobile friendly?
A: Yes — all quizzes and flashcards are fully responsive.

Q: Can I remove the branding?
A: Yes — you can control whether to show the “Powered by MyQuizGPT” link in the Settings page. The branding is optional and defaults to hidden.

Q: Does it store data on my server?
A: Yes — quizzes are stored in your WordPress database.

Q: Can users customize the theme?
A: Yes — quiz takers can switch between bright (light) and dark themes using the theme toggle button. Their preference is automatically saved in their browser for future visits.

Q: Does the plugin randomize questions?
A: Yes — MyQuizGPT WordPress Quiz Maker includes smart randomization that shuffles both questions and answer options for each quiz attempt, ensuring a unique experience every time and preventing answer memorization.
